content: Peer-divergence detection: standard approach is pairwise-distance / weighted-deviation from group mean-behavior; a faulty/diverging member shows abnormal distance to ALL peers while healthy members show only minor mutual deviation. DBSCAN or z-score-of-residual-from-group-mean are common simple implementations. Attribution is per-member (which one deviates), distinguishing it from pure group-level anomaly detection.
